description: This C# source file defines a test runner class 'ClientStreamTestRunner' for testing Orleans streaming functionalities, including handling dropped clients and verifying stream event delivery.

classes.name: ClientStreamTestRunner
classes.description: A class providing methods to test Orleans streaming scenarios, including client drop handling and event delivery verification.

methods.name: StreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Tests the producer's ability to handle a client drop and re-initialization, ensuring stream events are correctly produced before and after the drop.

methods.name: StreamConsumerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Tests the consumer's ability to handle a client drop, including re-subscribing and verifying event counts and delivery failure counts.

methods.name: SubscribeToStream
methods.description: Subscribes to a specified Orleans stream with a provided callback for incoming events.

methods.name: ProduceEventsFromClient
methods.description: Produces a specified number of events to a stream from a consumer perspective, verifying event consumption.

methods.name: GenerateEvents
methods.description: Generates and sends a sequence of events to a stream.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Checks whether the number of consumed events matches the number produced, asserting equality if specified.
